fields.description: SRAM bank-0 status byte at 0x0E000000. Read by the boot dispatch routine to select the boot path; written as 3 while the save area is being updated and as 0 once the cart ID is committed.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000dd0 reads 1 byte from SRAM 0x0E000000 via the SRAM read helper and dispatches on it; FUN_08000e04 writes value 3 to SRAM 0x0E000000 and FUN_08000ec0 writes value 0 to SRAM 0x0E000000 (both single-byte SRAM writes via FUN_08004d34). FUN_08000c78 invokes FUN_08000e04 then FUN_08000ec0 after mirroring the RAM image, so the resting value is 0 (matches baseline byte 0 = 0x00).
fields.name: save_status_flag

fields.description: First 6 characters of the 18-byte cart/build ID string stored at save offset 1. Read back and byte-compared against the ROM reference by the boot validator; written from ROM by the save init routine. Baseline decodes to '100305'.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d18 reads 0x12 (18) bytes from SRAM into a stack buffer and compares them byte-by-byte against the ROM reference (returns nonzero on full match); FUN_08000e5c writes 0x12 bytes from ROM to SRAM via FUN_08004d34. Baseline save offsets 1..6 hold ASCII '100305'.
fields.name: cart_build_code

fields.description: Separator underscore between the build code and the product code inside the 18-byte cart ID. Covered by the same 18-byte verify/copy as the surrounding ID bytes; baseline byte 7 is 0x5F ('_').
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d18 verifies save offsets 1..18 as one 0x12-byte unit (byte 7 included in the compare loop); FUN_08000e5c writes the same 0x12-byte unit via FUN_08004d34. Baseline offset 7 is '_'.
fields.name: cart_id_separator_a

fields.description: Middle 6 characters of the cart ID identifying the multicart product ('DM2in1', i.e. Duel Monsters 2-in-1 pack). Part of the verified 18-byte ID unit; baseline offsets 8..13 decode to 'DM2in1'.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d18 verifies save offsets 1..18 as one 0x12-byte unit (offsets 8..13 included); FUN_08000e5c writes the same unit via FUN_08004d34. Baseline offsets 8..13 hold ASCII 'DM2in1'.
fields.name: pack_product_code

fields.description: Separator underscore between the product code and the region/build suffix inside the 18-byte cart ID. Covered by the same 18-byte verify/copy; baseline byte 14 is 0x5F ('_').
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d18 verifies save offsets 1..18 as one 0x12-byte unit (byte 14 included in the compare loop); FUN_08000e5c writes the same 0x12-byte unit via FUN_08004d34. Baseline offset 14 is '_'.
fields.name: cart_id_separator_b

fields.description: Trailing 4 characters of the cart ID (region/build suffix). Part of the verified 18-byte ID unit; baseline offsets 15..18 decode to 'KDEH'.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d18 verifies save offsets 1..18 as one 0x12-byte unit (offsets 15..18 included); FUN_08000e5c writes the same unit via FUN_08004d34. Baseline offsets 15..18 hold ASCII 'KDEH'.
fields.name: build_region_suffix

fields.description: Remainder of SRAM bank 0 (offsets 0x13..0x1FFF): the tail of the 0x2000-byte RAM save-image mirrored into bank 0. All zeros in the live baseline (fresh/empty RAM image); nonzero gameplay data would appear here once the packed-in titles store state through this buffer.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c78 copies 0x2000 bytes from the RAM save buffer to SRAM 0x0E000000 (bank 0) via FUN_08004d34, which performs the byte copy in FUN_08004c10 plus a read-back verify with up to 3 retries. Baseline offsets 0x13..0x1FFF are all 0x00.
fields.name: bank0_ram_image_tail

fields.description: First byte of SRAM bank 1 (0x0E002000): copy of RAM save-image byte 0 written by the same mirror loop as bank 0. Bank 1 never receives the status-flag patches (those target bank 0 only), so this is the raw image byte; 0x00 in the baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c78 writes the same 0x2000-byte RAM image to SRAM 0x0E002000 via FUN_08004d34 (second of four mirror writes). Baseline offset 0x2000 is 0x00.
fields.name: bank1_status_copy

fields.description: First byte of SRAM bank 2 (0x0E004000): copy of RAM save-image byte 0 from the mirror loop. 0x00 in the baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c78 writes the same 0x2000-byte RAM image to SRAM 0x0E004000 via FUN_08004d34 (third of four mirror writes). Baseline offset 0x4000 is 0x00.
fields.name: bank2_status_copy

fields.description: First byte of SRAM bank 3 (0x0E006000): copy of RAM save-image byte 0 from the mirror loop. 0x00 in the baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c78 writes the same 0x2000-byte RAM image to SRAM 0x0E006000 via FUN_08004d34 (fourth of four mirror writes). Baseline offset 0x6000 is 0x00.
fields.name: bank3_status_copy

fields.description: SRAM bank 1 payload (offsets 0x2001..0x3FFF): verbatim copy of RAM save-image bytes 1..0x1FFF. All zeros in the baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c78 copies 0x2000 bytes from the RAM save buffer to SRAM 0x0E002000 via FUN_08004d34. Baseline offsets 0x2001..0x3FFF are all 0x00.
fields.name: bank1_ram_image_copy

fields.description: SRAM bank 2 payload (offsets 0x4001..0x5FFF): verbatim copy of RAM save-image bytes 1..0x1FFF. All zeros in the baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c78 copies 0x2000 bytes from the RAM save buffer to SRAM 0x0E004000 via FUN_08004d34. Baseline offsets 0x4001..0x5FFF are all 0x00.
fields.name: bank2_ram_image_copy

fields.description: SRAM bank 3 payload (offsets 0x6001..0x7FFF): verbatim copy of RAM save-image bytes 1..0x1FFF. All zeros in the baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000c78 copies 0x2000 bytes from the RAM save buffer to SRAM 0x0E006000 via FUN_08004d34. Baseline offsets 0x6001..0x7FFF are all 0x00.
fields.name: bank3_ram_image_copy

magic_signatures.description: First 4 bytes of the cart ID ('1003') at save offset 1
